description: This PHP file defines the class 'type_mime', which provides functionality to detect and verify MIME types of files using the PHP 'finfo' extension. It includes a method 'checkFile' that checks if a file's MIME type matches allowed types specified in configuration, returning error messages or true.

classes.name: type_mime
classes.description: A class that handles MIME type detection and validation for files.

methods.name: checkFile
methods.description: Checks whether the MIME type of a given file matches allowed types specified in the configuration, using the PHP 'finfo' extension.
